Dim gns_MemE As notesSession Dim gndb_MemE As notesDatabase Dim gnuiws_MemE As NotesUIWorkspace Dim gnv_Cont24_MemE As NotesView
Dim g_aContactsDeselectionnes_MemE As Variant Dim glnd_ContactInfo_MemE List As NotesDocument
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_MemE = "SL" Const gc_Element_MemE = "SDS_Memo"

Function MemE_lndAjouteContact(pnd_MemE As NotesDocument, p_courriel As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
MemE_lndAjouteContact = False
Set glnd_ContactInfo_MemE(p_Courriel) = pnd_MemE
MemE_lndAjouteContact = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_aAjouteDeselection(pnd_MemE As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
MemE_aAjouteDeselection = False
Dim v_NbContactsDeselectionnes As Long v_NbContactsDeselectionnes = Clng(xVar(pnd_MemE,"MemE_NbContactsDeselectionnes", 0)) If v_NbContactsDeselectionnes > 0 Then g_aContactsDeselectionnes_MemE = xVarArray(pnd_MemE,"MemE_ContactsDeselectionnes") End If
MemE_aAjouteDeselection = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Priorite As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Bannieres As Variant Dim a_Provinces As Variant Dim a_Fonctions As Variant Dim v_NbDest As Long Dim a_Destinataires As Variant Dim v_NbErr As Long Dim a_DestinatairesInvalides As Variant Dim v_NbSansContact As Long Dim a_ClientSansContact As Variant Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_CourContact As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim l As Long Dim v_Origin As String Dim v_CleOrigin As String Dim v_EnvoyePar As String
' Initialisations MemE_EnvoyerCourriel = False Call MemE_Initialisations Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ContactsSelectionnes", "") Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ContactsInvalides", "") Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ClientSansContact", "")
' Générer le tableau des destinataires a_Bannieres = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionBannieres") a_Provinces = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionProvinces") a_Fonctions = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionFonctions")
Call MemE_aAjouteDeselection(pnd)
If (Isarray(a_Bannieres) Or Isarray(a_Provinces) Or Isarray(a_Fonctions)) Then If Not MemE_GenDest_Clients(pnd, v_NbDest, a_Destinataires, v_NbErr, a_DestinatairesInvalides, _ v_NbSansContact, a_ClientSansContact) Then Exit Function End If End If
' Préparer les courriels 'Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_MemE) v_Origin = xGDK_xVarNDB(gndb_MemE.Title, "NDB_NomCourt", "", True) v_CleOrigin = xVar(pnd, "MemE_NoCourriel", "") v_EnvoyePar = xVar(pnd, "HistoUE", "")
Set nd = SIBO_CreerDocument(v_Origin, v_CleOrigin, p_Priorite, Now, v_EnvoyePar)
If nd Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("Subject", xVar(pnd, "Subject", "")) Set nrti = pnd.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.CopyItemToDocument(nd, "Body")
nd.Principal = xVar(pnd, "Principal", "") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("ReplyTo", xVar(pnd, "ReplyTo", ""))
' Envoyer le courriel aux destinataires A/Cc/Ccc If Isarray(xVarArray(pnd, "SendTo")) Or Isarray(xVarArray(pnd, "CopyTo")) Or Isarray(xVarArray(pnd, "BlindCopyTo")) Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SendTo", xVar(pnd, "SendTo", "")) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("CopyTo", xVar(pnd, "CopyTo", "")) Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("BlindCopyTo", xVar(pnd, "BlindCopyTo", ""))
'Envoyer le courriel Call SIBO_EnvoyerDocument(nd) 'Call nd.Send(False) 'Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SendTo", "") 'Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("CopyTo", "") 'Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("BlindCopyTo", "") End If
' Envoyer le courriel aux contacts sélectionnés For l = 1 To v_NbDest If a_Destinataires(l - 1) <> "" Then 'Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("SendTo", a_Destinataires(l - 1)) 'Call nd.Send(False) Set nd_CourContact = SIBO_CreerDocument(v_Origin, v_CleOrigin, p_Priorite, Now, v_EnvoyePar)
'Call nd.CopyAllItems(nd_CourContact) 'Items en doublon Call nd_CourContact .ReplaceItemValue("Subject", xVar(pnd, "Subject", "")) If nrti Is Nothing Then Set nrti = pnd.GetFirstItem("Body") End If Call nrti.CopyItemToDocument(nd_CourContact, "Body") nd_CourContact.Principal = xVar(pnd, "Principal", "") Call nd_CourContact.ReplaceItemValue("ReplyTo", xVar(pnd, "ReplyTo", "")) Call nd_CourContact.ReplaceItemValue("SendTo", a_Destinataires(l - 1))
Call MemE_RemplaceTag(nd_CourContact, a_Destinataires(l - 1))
Call SIBO_EnvoyerDocument(nd_CourContact) End If Next
' Changer le statut du document de courriel Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbContactsEnvoyes", "MemE_ContactsEnvoyes", v_NbDest, _ a_Destinataires) Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbContactsInvalides", "MemE_ContactsInvalides", v_NbErr, _ a_DestinatairesInvalides) Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbSansContact", "MemE_ClientSansContact", v_NbErr, _ a_DestinatairesInvalides) pnd.HistoDE = Now Call MemE_AssignerStatut(pnd, "90")
MemE_EnvoyerCourriel = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), xVarImplode(nd, "SendTo", ","), False) Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_GenDest_Contacts(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Fonctions As String, p_NbDest As Long, _ pa_Destinataires() As String, p_NbErr As Long, pa_DestinatairesInvalides() As String, _ p_IsSansContact As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_Courriel As String Dim v_CourrielValide As Variant Dim s As String Dim v As Variant Dim v_CourrielComplet As String
' Initialisations MemE_GenDest_Contacts = False
' Rechercher les contacts des clients sélectionnés Set ndc = gnv_Cont24_MemE.GetAllDocumentsByKey(xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument p_IsSansContact = True Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant) v_Maj = False
If xVar(nd, "Cont_Inactif", "") <> "1" Then If xVar(nd, "Cont_ContactCourriel", "") <> "1" Then v_Courriel = Fulltrim(xVar(nd, "Cont_ContactCourriel", "")) If v_Courriel <> "" Then If p_Fonctions <> "" Then s = |@IsNotMember(| & p_Fonctions & |; Cont_ContactFonction)| v = Evaluate(s, nd) If v(0) <> 1 Then v_Maj = True End If Else v_Maj = True End If End If End If
If v_Maj Then p_IsSansContact = False v_CourrielValide = Evaluate(|@ValidateInternetAddress([ADDRESS821] ; "| & v_Courriel & |")|) If v_CourrielValide(0) = "" Then
v_CourrielComplet = |"| & Fulltrim(xVar(nd, "Cont_Contact", "")) & |" <| & v_Courriel & |>| If Not ArrayContient(g_aContactsDeselectionnes_MemE, v_CourrielComplet) Then
Call MemE_lndAjouteContact(nd, v_CourrielComplet)
pa_Destinataires(p_NbDest) = v_CourrielComplet p_NbDest = p_NbDest + 1 If p_NbDest > Ubound(pa_Destinataires) Then Redim Preserve pa_Destinataires(Ubound(pa_Destinataires) + 100) As String End If
End If Else pa_DestinatairesInvalides(p_NbErr) = |"| & Fulltrim(xVar(nd, "Cont_Contact", "")) & |" <| & v_Courriel & |>| p_NbErr = p_NbErr + 1 If p_NbErr > Ubound(pa_DestinatairesInvalides) Then Redim Preserve pa_DestinatairesInvalides(Ubound(pa_DestinatairesInvalides) + 100) As String End If End If End If End If Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) End Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_InsererSignature(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nv As NotesView Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrti_SignatureDepartement As NotesRichTextItem
' Initialisations MemE_InsererSignature = False Call MemE_Initialisations
Set nv = gndb_MemE.GetView("V_AdmT") Set nd_Prof = nv.GetDocumentByKey("F_SISg", True) If Not (nd_Prof Is Nothing) Then If nd_Prof.HasItem("Prof_Signature") Then Set nrti_SignatureDepartement = nd_Prof.GetFirstItem("Prof_Signature") End If End If If Not (nrti_SignatureDepartement Is Nothing) Then Call nrti_SignatureDepartement.CopyItemToDocument(pnd, "Body") End If
MemE_InsererSignature = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub MemE_Initialisations If gns_MemE Is Nothing Then Set gns_MemE = New notesSession Set gndb_MemE = gns_MemE.CurrentDatabase Set gnuiws_MemE = New NotesUIWorkspace End If End Sub

Function MemE_AssignerStatut(pnd_MemE As Notesdocument, p_Statut As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
MemE_AssignerStatut = False
' Assigner le nouveau statut ' ------------------------------------ pnd_MemE.MemE_Statut = p_Statut pnd_MemE.MemE_StatutIcone= xIcnTabl(p_Statut, "MemE_Statut", True) pnd_MemE.MemE_StatutDesc = p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, "MemE_Statut", True)
' Ajouter le commentaire à l'historique ' --------------------------------------------------- If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_MemE, xVar(pnd_MemE, "MemE_StatutDesc", ""), "", "", True) Then Exit Function End If
MemE_AssignerStatut = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_GenererDestinataires(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NbDest As Long Dim a_Destinataires As Variant Dim v_NbErr As Long Dim a_DestinatairesInvalides As Variant Dim v_NbSansContact As Long Dim a_ClientSansContact As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem Dim a_ContactsDeselectionnes As Variant Dim v_NbContactsDeselectionnes As Long Dim v_ConserveDeselectionnes As Integer Dim l As Long Dim i As Long
' Initialisations MemE_GenererDestinataires = False Call MemE_Initialisations Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ContactsSelectionnes", "") Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ContactsInvalides", "") Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("MemE_ClientSansContact", "")
' Générer le tableau des destinataires If MemE_GenDest_Clients(pnd, v_NbDest, a_Destinataires, v_NbErr, a_DestinatairesInvalides, _ v_NbSansContact, a_ClientSansContact) Then
v_NbContactsDeselectionnes = Clng(xVar(pnd,"MemE_NbContactsDeselectionnes", 0)) If v_NbContactsDeselectionnes > 0 Then v_ConserveDeselectionnes = gnuiws_MemE.Prompt (PROMPT_YESNO, "Désélection", "Conserver la liste des contacts enlevés?") If v_ConserveDeselectionnes = 1 Then a_ContactsDeselectionnes = xVarArray(pnd,"MemE_ContactsDeselectionnes") a_Destinataires = Fulltrim(Arrayreplace(a_Destinataires,a_ContactsDeselectionnes,"")) v_NbDest = v_NbDest - v_NbContactsDeselectionnes Else Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbContactsDeselectionnes", "MemE_ContactsDeselectionnes", 0, _ a_ContactsDeselectionnes) End If End If
' Mettre à jour le document Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbContactsSelectionnes", "MemE_ContactsSelectionnes", v_NbDest, _ a_Destinataires) Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbContactsInvalides", "MemE_ContactsInvalides", v_NbErr, _ a_DestinatairesInvalides) Call MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd, "MemE_NbSansContact", "MemE_ClientSansContact", v_NbSansContact, _ a_ClientSansContact)
Print Cstr(v_NbDest) " contacts sélectionnés." MemE_GenererDestinataires = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Stop Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function MemE_RemplaceTag(pnd_MemE As NotesDocument, p_courriel As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
MemE_RemplaceTag = False
Dim v_ndCont As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nn As NotesName Dim v_ValeurItem As String
If nrti Is Nothing Then Set nrti = pnd_MemE.GetFirstItem("Body") End If
If Iselement(glnd_ContactInfo_MemE(p_Courriel)) Then Set v_ndCont = glnd_ContactInfo_MemE(p_Courriel) If Not (v_ndCont Is Nothing) Then Forall ni In v_ndCont.Items If ni.IsNames Then Set nn = New NotesName(ni.Text) v_ValeurItem = nn.Abbreviated Else v_ValeurItem = ni.Text End If If v_ValeurItem = "" Then v_ValeurItem = " " End If Call SItRT_Remplacer(nrti, "[" & ni.Name & "]", v_ValeurItem) End Forall End If End If
MemE_RemplaceTag = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub MemE_MajDestinataires(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItemNb As String, p_NomItemDest As String, p_NbDest As Long, _ pa_Destinataires As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Long Dim l As Long
Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItemNb, p_NbDest)
If p_NbDest > 0 Then For i = Lbound(pa_Destinataires) To Ubound(pa_Destinataires) l = l + Len(pa_Destinataires(i)) If l > 31000 Then Exit For End If Next
Redim Preserve pa_Destinataires(i - 1) As String Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItemDest, pa_Destinataires) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItemDest, "") End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function MemE_GenDest_Clients(pnd As NotesDocument, _ p_NbDest As Long, pa_Destinataires As Variant, _ p_NbErr As Long, pa_DestinatairesInvalides As Variant, _ p_NbSansContact As Long, pa_ClientSansContact As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Bannieres As Variant Dim a_Provinces As Variant Dim a_Fonctions As Variant Dim v_Fonctions As String Dim v_Formule As String Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument
Redim a_Destinataires(100) As String Redim a_DestinatairesInvalides(100) As String Redim a_ClientSansContact(100) As String Dim v_IsSansContact As Boolean
' Initialisations MemE_GenDest_Clients = False
' Initialisations / clients Call xSICl_Initialisation a_Bannieres = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionBannieres") a_Provinces = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionProvinces") a_Fonctions = xVarArray(pnd, "MemE_SelectionFonctions") If Not (Isarray(a_Bannieres) Or Isarray(a_Provinces) Or Isarray(a_Fonctions)) Then Messagebox "Au mons un critère de sélection doit être saisi.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End If
v_Formule = |Form = "F_Clie" & SDS_Icone = 174 & Clie_ClientCodeAct = 1| If Isarray(a_Bannieres) Then v_Formule = v_Formule & | & !@IsNotMember(SDS_Bannieres; "| & Implode(a_Bannieres, |":"|) & |")| End If If Isarray(a_Provinces) Then v_Formule = v_Formule & | & !@IsNotMember(Clie_ClientProvince; "| & Implode(a_Provinces, |":"|) & |")| End If
' Rechercher les clients qui rencontrent les critères de sélection ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set ndc = gndb_xSICl.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) If ndc.Count = 0 Then Messagebox "Aucun client ne rencontre les critères de sélection.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End If
' Initialisations / contacts Call xSICo_Initialisation Set gnv_Cont24_MemE = gndb_xSICo.GetView("V_Cont24") If Isarray(a_Fonctions) Then v_Fonctions = |"| & Implode(a_Fonctions, |":"|) & |"| End If
' Rechercher les contacts des clients sélectionnés ' ------------------------------------------------------------------- Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
Call MemE_GenDest_Contacts(nd, v_Fonctions, p_NbDest, a_Destinataires, p_NbErr, a_DestinatairesInvalides, v_IsSansContact)
If v_IsSansContact Then a_ClientSansContact(p_NbSansContact) = |(| & xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") & |) | & xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") p_NbSansContact = p_NbSansContact + 1 If p_NbSansContact > Ubound(a_ClientSansContact) Then Redim Preserve a_ClientSansContact(Ubound(a_ClientSansContact) + 100) As String End If End If Loop
If p_NbDest = 0 Then Messagebox "Aucun contact ne rencontre les critères de sélection.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End If
Redim Preserve a_Destinataires(p_NbDest - 1) As String pa_Destinataires = a_Destinataires If p_NbErr > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_DestinatairesInvalides(p_NbErr - 1) As String pa_DestinatairesInvalides = a_DestinatairesInvalides End If If p_NbSansContact > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_ClientSansContact(p_NbSansContact - 1) As String pa_ClientSansContact = a_ClientSansContact End If MemE_GenDest_Clients = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_MemE, gc_Element_MemE, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare
Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SDSPP" Use "x_SIRR" Use "x_SDSBB" Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "x_BCom" Use "SI_Historique" Use "wsc_Proposition" Use "x_Tabl"

Dim gns_SDSPP As NotesSession
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SDSPP = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSPP = "SDS_Propositions2"

Sub SDSPP_AssignerSecurite(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument, p_Reinitialiser As Boolean) ' p_Reinitialiser = Mettre à jour la sécurité même s'il n'y a aucun changement On Error Goto GererErreur Dim a_Lecteur As Variant Dim a_Auteur As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Maj As Boolean ' Maj le superviseur ' ------------------------- v_Maj = SDSPP_SecSuperviseur(pnd_Prop)
' Calculer la sécurité ' --------------------------- Call SDSPP_SecCalculer(pnd_Prop, a_Lecteur, a_Auteur)
If p_Reinitialiser Or xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Lecteur", ";") <> Implode(a_Lecteur, ";") Then If pnd_Prop.Hasitem("Lecteur") Then Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", a_Lecteur) Else Set ni = New NotesItem(pnd_Prop, "Lecteur", a_Auteur, READERS) End If v_Maj = True End If
If p_Reinitialiser Or xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Auteur", ";") <> Implode(a_Auteur, ";") Then If pnd_Prop.Hasitem("Lecteur") Then Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", a_Auteur) Else Set ni = New NotesItem(pnd_Prop, "Auteur", a_Auteur, AUTHORS) End If v_Maj = True End If
' Assigner les changements à la proposition ' ---------------------------------- If v_Maj Then Call pnd_Prop.Save(True, False) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSPP_RepresentantValide(p_NoRepresentant As String, p_Pays As String, p_Province As String, _ pa_CodeCommissions() As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nd_SIRR As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_NotesId As String Dim v_NoEquipe As String Dim nd_SIRR_U As NotesDocument Dim nd_Comm As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
SDSPP_RepresentantValide = False
' Identifier le représentant responsable de la proposition ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------- If p_NoRepresentant = "" Then ' 3 - Un représentant est requis pour créer une proposition.. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 3, "", Cstr(p_NoRepresentant)), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") & " (1)" Exit Function End If Set nd_SIRR = xSIRR_xndRepr(p_NoRepresentant, True) If nd_SIRR Is Nothing Then Set nd_SIRR = xSIRR_xndEqui(p_NoRepresentant, True) If Not (nd_SIRR Is Nothing) Then Set ndc = nuiws.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_xSIRR.Server, _ gndb_xSIRR.FilePath, "V_Repr12", "Sélection s'un représantant", "Sélectionnez le représenant à associer à la proposition.", p_NoRepresentant) If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If Set nd_SIRR = ndc.GetFirstDocument Else ' 0 - & n'est pas un représentant autorisé à créer de nouvelles propositions. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 0, "", Cstr(p_NoRepresentant)), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") & " (1)" Exit Function End If End If ' Le représentant doit avoir un Id Notes v_NotesId = xVar(nd_SIRR, "Repr_NotesId", "") If v_NotesId = "" Then ' 0 - & n'est pas un représentant autorisé à créer de nouvelles propositions. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 0, "", xVar(nd_SIRR, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "")), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") & " (3)" Exit Function End If
v_NoEquipe = xVar(nd_SIRR, "Repr_NoEquipe", "") ' Si l'utilisateur courant est un représentant et n'est pas le représentant responsable If gns_SDSPP.UserName <> v_NotesId Then Set nd_SIRR_U = xSIRR_xndRepr_Id(gns_SDSPP.UserName, "60") If Not (nd_SIRR_U Is Nothing) Then ' Si l'utilisateur courant n'est pas un directeur et ne fait pas partie de la même équipe 'If Not nd_SIRR_U.Contains("Repr_SDSPropositions") Then ' Call nd_SIRR_U.ReplaceItemValue("Repr_SDSPropositions", "") 'End If Set ni = nd_SIRR_U.GetFirstItem("Repr_SDSPropositions") If Not ni.Contains("DIR") Then If xVar(nd_SIRR_U, "Repr_NoEquipe", "") <> v_NoEquipe Then ' 0 - Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à créer une nouvelle proposition pour ce client ou ce projet. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") & " (10)" Exit Function End If End If End If End If
' Si le représentant est un directeur If Not nd_SIRR.HasItem("Repr_SDSPropositions") Then Call nd_SIRR.ReplaceItemValue("Repr_SDSPropositions", "") End If Set ni = nd_SIRR.GetFirstItem("Repr_SDSPropositions") If ni.Contains("XC") Then pa_CodeCommissions(0) = "" pa_CodeCommissions(1) = "" Elseif ni.Contains("DIR") Then pa_CodeCommissions(0) = xSDSPP_xVarProf("Prof_DirCommissionsRep", "") pa_CodeCommissions(1) = "" Else ' Le représentant doit avoir une table de commissions pa_CodeCommissions(0) = xSIRR_xVarComm(v_NoEquipe, p_Pays, p_Province, "Comm_CodeCommissions", "") If pa_CodeCommissions(0) <> "" Then pa_CodeCommissions(1) = xSDSPP_xVarProf("Prof_DirCommissionsDir", "") Else ' 0 - & n'est pas un représentant autorisé à créer de nouvelles propositions. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 0, "", xVar(nd_SIRR, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "")), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") & " (9)" Exit Function End If End If
SDSPP_RepresentantValide = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), Cstr(p_NoRepresentant), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_SIHiBatirHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Langue As String) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script ajoute une ligne à l'historique du document. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v As Variant
Dim v_NoDerniereLigne As Long Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Long Dim j As Long Dim v_NomItemUser As Variant
SDSPP_SIHiBatirHistorique = False
' Initialisations ' ------------------ Call SIHi_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_SIHi.CurrentDatabase Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd.Form = "F_SIHi" ' Si le document contient un historique, le supprimer ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemRT_SIHi) Call pnd.Save(True, False)
' Créer le nouvel item de l'historique ' ----------------------------------------------- Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(pnd, gc_NomItemRT_SIHi)
' Boucler sur toutes les lignes d'historique à afficher ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- i = 0 Do While pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i)) nd.Date = xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i), "") v = Evaluate( { @Name([CN]; "} & xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i), "") & {")}) nd.Utilisateur = v(0) v = xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i), "") If v <> "" Then nd.Statut = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 57, p_Langue, "") & " : " & v Else nd.Statut = "" End If nd.Commentaire = xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i), "") Call nd.RenderToRTItem(nrti)
i = i + 1 Loop
Call pnd.Save(True, False) SDSPP_SIHiBatirHistorique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_SecSuperviseur(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument) As Boolean ' Initialiser le superviseur de la proposition On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_NoSuperviseur As Variant Dim a_NoSuperviseurProp As Variant Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim i As Integer Dim v_IdSuperviseur As String Dim ni As NotesItem
SDSPP_SecSuperviseur = False ' Maj le superviseur ' -------------------------- a_NoSuperviseur = xSIRR_aSuperviseursRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), True) a_NoSuperviseurProp = xVarArray(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoSuperviseur") v_Maj = False If Isarray(a_NoSuperviseur) <> Isarray(a_NoSuperviseurProp) Then v_Maj = True Elseif Isarray(a_NoSuperviseur) Then If Implode(a_NoSuperviseur, ";") <> Implode(a_NoSuperviseurProp, ";") Then v_Maj = True End If End If
If v_Maj Then pnd_Prop.Prop_NoSuperviseur = a_NoSuperviseur
If Isarray(a_NoSuperviseur) Then For i = Lbound(a_NoSuperviseur) To Ubound(a_NoSuperviseur) v_IdSuperviseur = xSIRR_xVarRepr(a_NoSuperviseur(i), "Repr_NotesId", "", True) If i = Lbound(a_NoSuperviseur) Then Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Prop_IdSuperviseur", v_IdSuperviseur) Set ni = pnd_Prop.GetFirstItem("Prop_IdSuperviseur") Else Call ni.AppendToTextList(v_IdSuperviseur) End If Next Else Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Prop_IdSuperviseur", "") End If End If
SDSPP_SecSuperviseur = v_Maj Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(p_Destinataires As String, p_Dest As String, pa_Id As Variant, _ pa_xTo As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire = False
If Instr(p_Destinataires, p_Dest) > 0 Then ' S'assurer que la valeurs à ajouter est un array If Not Isarray(pa_Id) Then If pa_Id <> "" Then pa_Id = Evaluate(|"| & pa_Id & |"|) Else Exit Function End If End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'array des destinataires If Isarray(pa_xTo) Then pa_xTo = Arrayappend(pa_xTo, pa_Id) Else pa_xTo = pa_Id End If SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_EstAuteur(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Valeur retournée:` ' 0 = Lecteur, 1 = Auteur, 2 = Admin '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_UserRoles As Variant Dim a_Auteurs As Variant
' Initialisations SDSPP_EstAuteur = 0 Call SDSPP_Initialisations
a_UserRoles = Evaluate(|@UserRoles|) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_UserRoles, "[Admin]")) Then SDSPP_EstAuteur = 2 Exit Function End If
' Extrait la liste des auteurs a_Auteurs = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(AuteurAdmin : Auteur))|, pnd_Prop) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_Auteurs, gns_SDSPP.UserName)) Then SDSPP_EstAuteur = 1 Exit Function End If
Forall v_Auteur In a_Auteurs ' Rôle If Left(v_Auteur, 1) = "[" Then If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_UserRoles, v_Auteur)) Then SDSPP_EstAuteur = 1 Exit Function End If End If End Forall Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSPP_SecCalculer(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument, pa_Lecteur As Variant, pa_Auteur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Securite As String Dim v_SecLecteurs As String Dim v_SecAuteurs As String Dim a_IdCreateur As Variant Dim a_IdRepresentant As Variant Dim a_IdSuperviseur As Variant Dim nd_SICTStatut As NotesDocument Dim a_IdVerificateur As Variant Dim a_IdDirecteur As Variant Dim a_IdTechnique As Variant
pa_Lecteur = "" pa_Auteur = "" v_Statut = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
' Déterminer les paramètres de sécurité ' ----------------------------------------------------- v_Securite = xSDSPP_xComplTabl(v_Statut, "Prop_Statut_FR", "3", True) If Instr(v_Securite, ";") > 0 Then v_SecLecteurs = Strleft(v_Securite, ";") v_SecAuteurs = Strright(v_Securite, ";") Else v_SecLecteurs = v_Securite End If
a_IdCreateur = xVar(pnd_Prop, "HistoUC", "") a_IdRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdRepresentant", "") If a_IdCreateur = a_IdRepresentant Then a_IdCreateur = "" End If
a_IdSuperviseur = xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_IdSuperviseur", "")
' Vérificateur a_IdVerificateur = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_VerificateurDestinataire", "", True)
' Directeur a_IdDirecteur = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_DirecteurDestinataire", "", True)
If Not Isarray(a_IdDirecteur) Then If a_IdDirecteur = "" Then a_IdDirecteur = xVarProf("Prof_DirecteurDestinataire", "") End If End If
' Technique a_IdTechnique = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_TechniqueDestinataire", "", True)
' Lecteurs Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "C", a_IdCreateur, pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "D", a_IdDirecteur , pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "R", a_IdRepresentant, pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "S", a_IdSuperviseur, pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "V", a_IdVerificateur, pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "V", "[Verificateur]", pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "D", a_IdDirecteur , pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "D", "[Directeur]", pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "T", a_IdTechnique, pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "T", "[Technique]", pa_Lecteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecLecteurs, "L", "[Lecteur" & v_Statut & "]", pa_Lecteur) If Not Isarray(pa_Lecteur) Then pa_Lecteur = Evaluate(|""|) End If
' Auteurs Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "C", a_IdCreateur, pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "R", a_IdRepresentant, pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "S", a_IdSuperviseur, pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "V", a_IdVerificateur , pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "V", "[Verificateur]", pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "D", a_IdDirecteur , pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "D", "[Directeur]", pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "T", a_IdTechnique , pa_Auteur) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_SecAuteurs, "T", "[Technique]", pa_Auteur) If Not Isarray(pa_Auteur) Then pa_Auteur = Evaluate(|""|) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSPP_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_Statut As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_RepliqueLocale As Boolean Dim v_Destinataires As String Dim nd_SICTStatut As NotesDocument Dim v_DestSendTo As String Dim v_DestCopyTo As String Dim a_IdCreateur As Variant Dim a_IdRepresentant As Variant Dim a_IdSuperviseur As Variant Dim a_IdVerificateur As Variant Dim a_IdDirecteur As Variant Dim a_IdTechnique As Variant Dim a_SendTo As Variant Dim a_CopyTo As Variant Dim v_BlindCopyTo As Variant Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim ni_EnvoyerCourriel As NotesItem Dim v_NbProposition As Double
SDSPP_EnvoyerCourriel = False
'v_Langue = "FR" ' Toujours envoyer dans langue du représentant v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True)
v_Statut = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
' Déterminer les destinataires en fonction du statut ' -------------------------------------------------------------------- v_Destinataires = xSDSPP_xComplTabl(v_Statut, "Prop_Statut_FR", "2", True)
If Instr(v_Destinataires, ";") > 0 Then v_DestSendTo = Strleft(v_Destinataires, ";") v_DestCopyTo = Strright(v_Destinataires, ";") Else v_DestSendTo = v_Destinataires End If
If v_DestSendTo = "" Then Exit Function End If
a_IdCreateur = xVar(pnd_Prop, "HistoUC", "") a_IdRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdRepresentant", "") If a_IdCreateur <> a_IdRepresentant Then a_IdCreateur = "" End If a_IdSuperviseur = xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_IdSuperviseur", "")
' Vérificateur a_IdVerificateur = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_VerificateurDestinataire", "", True)
' Directeur a_IdDirecteur = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_DirecteurDestinataire", "", True)
If Not Isarray(a_IdDirecteur) Then If a_IdDirecteur = "" Then a_IdDirecteur = xVarProf("Prof_DirecteurDestinataire", "") End If End If
' Technique a_IdTechnique = xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_TypeProposition", ""), "TpPp_TechniqueDestinataire", "", True)
' ajouter Techique
' Destinataire - SendTo Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "C", a_IdCreateur, a_SendTo) 'If SDSPPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "R", a_IdRepresentant, a_SendTo) Then ' v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) 'End If Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "R", a_IdRepresentant, a_SendTo)
Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "S", a_IdSuperviseur, a_SendTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "V", a_IdVerificateur, a_SendTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "D", a_IdDirecteur, a_SendTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestSendTo, "T", a_IdTechnique, a_SendTo)
' Destinataire - CopyTo Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "C", a_IdCreateur, a_CopyTo) If SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "R", a_IdRepresentant, a_CopyTo) Then 'v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) End If Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "S", a_IdSuperviseur, a_CopyTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "V", a_IdVerificateur, a_CopyTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "D", a_IdDirecteur, a_CopyTo) Call SDSPP_AjouterDestinataire(v_DestCopyTo, "T", a_IdTechnique, a_CopyTo)
'EnvoyerCourriel: pnd_Prop.Temp_Comm = p_Commentaire ' Inclure le commentaire du changement de statut dans le courriel
pnd_Prop.Temp_NomClient =xEvaluate(|@If(!@IsNull(Prop_ClientNomInterne); Prop_ClientNomInterne; @IsNull(Prop_ClientNoFmt); Prop_ClientNom; (Prop_ClientNom1 : Prop_ClientNom2)) |, pnd_Prop)
Set ni_EnvoyerCourriel = xni(pnd_Prop, "SIWF_EnvoyerCourriel", "") If Not ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Contains(v_Statut) Then ' Statut;Commentaire;Principal Call ni_EnvoyerCourriel.AppendToTextList(v_Statut & ";" & p_Commentaire & ";" & gns_xBCom.UserName) End If
Call pnd_Prop.RemoveItem("Temp_Comm") Call pnd_Prop.RemoveItem("Temp_NomClient") Call pnd_Prop.Save(True, False)
SDSPP_EnvoyerCourriel = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_NouvelleProposition(p_Origine As String, p_NoRepresentant As String, _ p_Pays As String, p_Province As String, pnd_PNav As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur

Function SDSPP_ChangerStatut(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, p_Statut As String, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_StatutDesc As String
' Initialisations SDSPP_ChangerStatut = False
Set gns_SDSPP = New NotesSession Call SDSPP_Initialisations
v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True)
' Annuler bon de commande If p_Statut = "99" Then If Not SDSPP_AnnulerBonsCommande(pnd_BCom, pnd_Prop) Then Exit Function End If End If
' Assigner statut de la proposition v_Statut = xCompl1Tabl(p_Statut, "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, True)
If v_Statut > "0" Then Dim ws_Proposition As New cl_Proposition If ws_Proposition.ChangerStatut(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""),v_Statut) Then SDSPP_ChangerStatut = True Exit Function End If End If
SDSPP_ChangerStatut = True Exit Function

Function SIBO_CreerDocument(p_Origine As String, p_CleOrigine As String, p_Priorite As Variant, _ p_DateEnvoi As Variant, p_EnvoyePar As String) As NotesDocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de créer un document dans la base de documents SIBO. ' Paramètres: ' p_Origine String. La base de documents à l'origine du courriel. ' p_CleOrigine String. La clé du documents duquel provient l'information ' p_Priorite Variant. La priorité du courriel. ' p_DateEnvoi Variant. La date et l'heure d'envoi du courriel.
' Valeur retournée ' NotesDocument. Le document du courriel qui a été construit. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Memo As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim ni_Auteurs As NotesItem Dim ni As NotesItem
'Initialisations Set SIBO_CreerDocument = Nothing Call SIBO_Initialisations Call xSIBO_Initialisations
' Créer le memo Set nd_Memo = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSIBO)
nd_Memo.Form = "Memo" nd_Memo.Memo_NoEnvoi = xUnique nd_Memo.Memo_Origine = p_Origine nd_Memo.Memo_OrigineCle = p_CleOrigine nd_Memo.Memo_Priorite = p_Priorite nd_Memo.Memo_DateEnvoi = p_DateEnvoi nd_Memo.Memo_EnvoyePar = p_EnvoyePar
' Assigner le statut (brouillon) v_Statut = "0" nd_Memo.Memo_Statut = v_Statut nd_Memo.Memo_StatutDesc = xSIBO_xDescTabl(v_Statut, "Memo_Statut", True) nd_Memo.Memo_StatutIcone= xSIBO_xIcnTabl(v_Statut, "Memo_Statut", True)
' Historique nd_Memo.HistoDC = Now nd_Memo.HistoUC = gns_SIBO.UserName
Call nd_Memo.Save(True, False)
Set SIBO_CreerDocument = nd_Memo Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIBO, gc_Element_SIBO, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIBO_EnvoyerDocument(p_Courriel As Variant) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'indiquer que le courrier est prêt à être envoyé. ' Paramètres: ' p_Courriel Variant. Le document ou NoEnvoi du courriel '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Memo As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String
'Initialisations Call SIBO_Initialisations
SIBO_EnvoyerDocument = False
' Si p_Courriel est un document If Datatype(p_Courriel) = 35 Then If p_Courriel Isa "NotesDocument" Then Set nd_Memo = p_Courriel End If Else ' Si p_Courriel est un string Set nd_Memo = xSIBO_xndMemo(Cstr(p_Courriel), True) End If
If Not nd_Memo Is Nothing Then
' Assigner le statut v_Statut = "1" nd_Memo.Memo_Statut = v_Statut nd_Memo.Memo_StatutDesc = xSIBO_xDescTabl(v_Statut, "Memo_Statut", True) nd_Memo.Memo_StatutIcone= xSIBO_xIcnTabl(v_Statut, "Memo_Statut", True)
' Historique nd_Memo.HistoDM = Now nd_Memo.HistoUM = gns_SIBO.UserName Call nd_Memo.Save(True, False)
SIBO_EnvoyerDocument = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIBO, gc_Element_SIBO, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSBB" ou "SDSBB" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSBB" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prod" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSBB As Notesdatabase

Function xSDSBB_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.

xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = 0

' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem

Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSP" ou "SDSP" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSP" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prop" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSPP As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSPP As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSDSPP As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSDSPP As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Prop_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prop_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Site_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site21_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_MOpt_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_MOpt_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSPP = "SDSPP" ' Inscrire le nom de la base de documents, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomVueProp_xSDSPP = "V_Prop20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleProp_xSDSPP = "Prop_NoProposition" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite_xSDSPP = "V_Site20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleSite_xSDSPP = "Site_NoSite" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite21_xSDSPP = "V_Site21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemMOpt_xSDSPP = "MOpt_Code" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueMOpt_xSDSPP = "V_MOpt20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SICl" Use "x_PJ" Use "x_SIRR" '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Cet agent envoie un courriel aux représentants Projeto SDS lorsque le statut du bon de commande est : ' 00 - Nouveau ' 90 - Facturé '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
Dim gnd_ClieSICl As NotesDocument Dim gnv_CliePJ As NotesView
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_WFBCF"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_ClieSICl As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmtPrecedent As String Dim ni_EnvoyerCourriel As NotesItem Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Print "Début" Call A_Initialisations
Set nv = gndb_A.GetView("V_BCom23") ' Vue des bons de commande à envoyer par courriel
' Boucler sur les bons de commande en attente d'envoie Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_Maj = False
Set ni_EnvoyerCourriel = nd.GetFirstItem("BCom_EnvoyerCourriel")
If ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Contains("F") Then
' Si statut = facturé et le type <> formation -> envoyer le courriel If xVar(nd, "BCom_Statut", "") = "90" And xVar(nd, "BCom_Type", "") <> "FM" Then If A_EnvoyerCourriel(nd,v_ClientNoFmtPrecedent, v_NbLus) Then v_Maj = True End If Else v_Maj = True End If ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Values = Fulltrim(Replace(ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Values, "F", "")) End If
If ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Contains("N") Then
' Si statut = nouveau et le type <> formation -> envoyer le courriel If xVar(nd, "BCom_Statut", "") = "00" And xVar(nd, "BCom_Type", "") <> "FM" Then If A_EnvoyerCourriel(nd,v_ClientNoFmtPrecedent, v_NbLus) Then v_Maj = True End If Else v_Maj = True End If ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Values = FullTrim(Replace(ni_EnvoyerCourriel.Values, "N", "")) End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.save(True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If
Loop
Print "Fin : A_WF\BCom" & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function A_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_ClientNoFmtPrecedent As String, p_NbLus As Long) As Boolean ' Le script permet d'envoyer un courriel d'avis de facturation aux représentants projeto
On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 4294 Resume Next ' Unable to send mail, no match found in Name & Address Book(s)
Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_NoDept As String Dim nv_CliePJ As NotesView Dim nd_CliePJ As NotesDocument Dim v_Langue As String Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim a_SendTo As Variant Dim i As Integer
A_EnvoyerCourriel = False
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "")
If p_ClientNoFmtPrecedent = "" Then p_ClientNoFmtPrecedent = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") Set gnd_ClieSICl = xSICl_xndClie(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) Else If p_NbLus > 1 And v_ClientNoFmt <> p_ClientNoFmtPrecedent Then p_ClientNoFmtPrecedent = v_ClientNoFmt Set gnd_ClieSICl = Nothing Set gndb_xPJ = Nothing Set gnv_CliePJ = Nothing End If End If
' Recherche des représentants du client dans projeto If gnd_ClieSICl Is Nothing Then Set gnd_ClieSICl = xSICl_xndClie(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) End If
If Not gnd_ClieSICl Is Nothing Then
If xVar(gnd_ClieSICl, "Clie_ClientPays", "") = "US" Then v_NoDept = "62" Else v_NoDept = "60" End If
If gndb_xPJ Is Nothing Then Call Initialisation_xPJ(v_NoDept) End If
If gnv_CliePJ Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CliePJ = gndb_xPJ.GetView("V_Clie3") End If
Set nd_CliePJ = gnv_CliePJ.Getdocumentbykey(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", ""),True)
If nd_CLiePJ Is Nothing Then Exit function End If
If Instr(Lcase(gndb_A.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement a_SendTo = gns_A.UserName Else a_SendTo = xVar(nd_CliePJ, "Clie_ChargeCompteID", "")
If Isarray(a_SendTo) Then
' Déterminer langue du courriel For i = 0 To Ubound(a_SendTo) v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr_Id(a_SendTo(i), v_NoDept, "Repr_Langue", "FR") If v_Langue = "EN" Then Exit For End If Next
Else v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr_Id(a_SendTo, v_NoDept, "Repr_Langue", "FR") End If
End If
End If
' Construire le courriel
Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_A)
nd_Temp.Temp_Client = Evaluate({@If(@IsNull(BCom_ClientNoFmt) | BCom_ClientOccasionnel; BCom_ClientNom; @Trim(BCom_ClientNom1 + " " + BCom_ClientNom2) + " (" + BCom_ClientNoFmt + ")")}, pnd_BCom) nd_Temp.Temp_ClientNom = Evaluate({@If(@IsNull(BCom_ClientNoFmt) | BCom_ClientOccasionnel; BCom_ClientNom; BCom_ClientNomInterne + " (" + BCom_ClientNoFmt + ")")}, pnd_BCom) nd_Temp.BCom_NoBonCommande = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommande", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutDescFR = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutDescFR", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutDescEN = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutDescEN", "") nd_Temp.BCom_DescSommaire = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_DescSommaire", "") nd_Temp.BCom_TypeDesc = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_TypeDesc", "")
Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_Temp, "A_WFBCom_S:" & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_Statut", "00"), v_Langue, a_SendTo, "", "", 0, "")
' Ajouter le lien vers le bon de commande Set nrti = nd_Courriel.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.AppendDocLink(pnd_BCom, "Bon de commande")
If Not nd_Courriel Is Nothing Then
' Envoyer le courriel If Instr(Lcase(gndb_A.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement nd_Courriel.SendTo = gns_A.UserName nd_Courriel.CopyTo = "" Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) Else If xVarElem(nd_Courriel, "SendTo", 0, "") <> "" Then Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) End If End If End If
A_EnvoyerCourriel = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub A_Initialisations Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End Sub

Sub BCR_acRechercherDocuments(p_NomMasque As String, p_ModeleDossier As String, _ p_Parents As Integer, p_TypeIcone As Integer, p_WebService As Boolean) %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Effectuer une recherche. Paramètres: p_NomMasque String. Le nom du masque permettant la saisie des critères de la recherche. p_NomDossier String. Le nom du dossier de recherche de l'utilisateur. p_Parents Long. Le nombre de niveaux qu'il faut remonter pour trouver les documents parents. Si 0, ajoute les documents sélectionnés dans le dossier de recherche. Si > 0, ajoute les documents parents correspondant au niveau de recherche (2 = 2e parent). Si < 0, ajoute seulement le documents parents du niveau spécifié. p_TypeIcone Integer. Le numéro de l'icone à afficher dans la vue de sélection du rappel de recherches. p_WebService Boolean. Si true, utilise le web service pour exécuter la recherche. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %ENDREM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_NomVue As String Dim v_NomDossier As String Dim nd_Criteres As NotesDocument Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_FormuleDateCandidature As String Dim v_FormuleProfilSommaire As String Dim v_FormuleAutre As String Dim v_NbResultats As Long
' Initialisations Call SIRe_Initialisations
' Vérifier la présence d'un index FT If Not gndb_SIRe.IsFTIndexed Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 126, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 122, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Saisir les paramètres de la recherche Set gnuiws_SIRe = New NotesUIWorkspace If SIRe_SaisirCriteres(p_NomMasque, False, nd_Criteres) Then Dim cl_Chronometre As New cl_SIChronometre Call cl_Chronometre.Demarrer
' Construire la formule de recherche If SIRe_ConstruireFormule(nd_Criteres, v_Formule, v_FormuleAutre) Then
' Recherche entonnoir, identifier la vue de recherche If xVar(nd_Criteres, "Rech_Entonnoir", "") = "1" Then v_NomVue = SIRe_NomVueCourante If Left(v_NomVue, 1) <> "D" Then v_NomVue = xVarSIRH_User(gns_SIRe.UserName, p_NomMasque, _ "SIRH_CodeRecherche", "") If v_NomVue = "" Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 208, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 122, "", "") Exit Sub End If End If End If
' Rechercher les documents v_NomDossier = SIRe_DossierNom(SIRe_NoEmploye(""), True) If p_WebService Then Dim ws_SIRecherches As New cl_SIRecherches v_NbResultats = ws_SIRecherches.RechercherDocuments(p_NomMasque, v_Formule, _ v_NomVue, v_NomDossier, p_ModeleDossier, p_Parents, p_TypeIcone, gns_SIRe.UserName) Else v_NbResultats = SIRe_RechercherDocuments(p_NomMasque, v_Formule, v_NomVue, _ v_NomDossier, p_ModeleDossier, p_Parents, True, p_TypeIcone, gns_SIRe.UserName) End If
' Ouvrir le dossier de recherche Call SIRe_AfficherResultat(v_NbResultats, v_NomDossier, _ cl_Chronometre.Arreter) End If End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIRe, gc_Element_SIRe, Lsi_info(2), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBRBCom_hsSelectionnerEmployesAffectes ' ---------------------- ' Sélection d'un employé ' ---------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Emp As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Emp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim v_ServeurEm As String Dim v_FichierEm As String Dim v_NoEmploye As Variant Dim a_NoEmployers As Variant Dim a_NomEmployers As Variant Dim v_EmployersNoExistants As Variant Dim v_EmployersNomExistants As Variant Dim i As Long
' Initialisations Call DBRBCom_Initialisations
v_ServeurEm = xVar(gnd_DBRBCom, "SF_ServeurSIEm", gndb_DBRBCom.Server) v_FichierEm = xVar(gnd_DBRBCom, "SF_FichierSIEm", "")
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_DBRBCom.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur
' Afficher la liste des employés Set ndc_Emp = gnuiws_DBRBCom.PickListCollection( PICKLIST_CUSTOM, True, v_ServeurEm, v_FichierEm,_ "V_Empl27", "Employés", "Choisir les employés à rechercher")
If ndc_Emp.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
' Vérifier que l'utilisateur a fait un choix If ndc_Emp.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
ReDim a_NoEmployers(ndc_Emp.Count-1) ReDim a_NomEmployers(ndc_Emp.Count-1) Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Emp.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd_Emp = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Emp.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
a_NoEmployers(i) = CStr(xvar(nd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0)) a_NomEmployers(i) = xvar(nd_Emp, "Empl_NomEmploye", "") i = i + 1 Loop
v_EmployersNoExistants = xVarArray(gnd_DBRBCom, "BCom_AffecterRecherche") v_EmployersNomExistants = xVarArray(gnd_DBRBCom, "Rech_NomPersAffecter") If IsArray(v_EmployersNoExistants) Then v_EmployersNoExistants = FullTrim(ArrayUnique(ArrayAppend(v_EmployersNoExistants, a_NoEmployers), 0)) If IsArray(v_EmployersNomExistants) Then v_EmployersNomExistants = FullTrim(ArrayUnique(ArrayAppend(v_EmployersNomExistants, a_NomEmployers), 0)) Else v_EmployersNomExistants = a_NomEmployers End If Else v_EmployersNoExistants = a_NoEmployers v_EmployersNomExistants = a_NomEmployers End If gnd_DBRBCom.BCom_AffecterRecherche = v_EmployersNoExistants gnd_DBRBCom.Rech_NomPersAffecter = v_EmployersNomExistants Call gnuid_DBRBCom.Refresh
FinSub : Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_DBRBCom, gc_Element_DBRBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBRBCom_hsSelectionnerGroupes ' ------------------------------------------ ' Sélection d'un/des groupe(s) d'affectation ' ------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Grou As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Grou As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim v_ValeursExistantes As Variant Dim v_ValeursNomsExistantes As Variant
Dim i As Long
'Initialisations Call DBRBCom_Initialisations
' Sélectionner un/des groupe(s) ' -----------------------------
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_DBRBCom.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub
Set ndc_Grou = gnuiws_DBRBCom.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, _ True, gndb_DBRBCom.server, gndb_DBRBCom.FilePath, "V_Grou20",_ "Groupes", "Choisissez un groupe .")
' Vérifier que l'utilisateur a fait un choix If ndc_Grou Is Nothing Or ndc_Grou.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Grou = ndc_Grou.Getfirstdocument
ReDim a_GroupesAff(ndc_Grou.Count - 1) Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Grou.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd_Grou = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Grou.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
a_GroupesAff(i) = xvar(nd_Grou, "Grou_Code", "") i = i + 1 Loop
If Not(IsArray(a_GroupesAff)) Then Exit Sub End If
v_ValeursExistantes = xVarArray(gnd_DBRBCom, "BCom_AffecterRecherche") ' valeurs recherchées v_ValeursNomsExistantes = xVarArray(gnd_DBRBCom, "Rech_NomPersAffecter") ' valeurs affichées
If IsArray(v_ValeursExistantes) Then v_ValeursExistantes = FullTrim(ArrayUnique((ArrayAppend(v_ValeursExistantes , a_GroupesAff)),0)) v_ValeursNomsExistantes = FullTrim(ArrayUnique((ArrayAppend(v_ValeursNomsExistantes , a_GroupesAff)),0)) Else v_ValeursExistantes = a_GroupesAff v_ValeursNomsExistantes = a_GroupesAff End If gnd_DBRBCom.BCom_AffecterRecherche = v_ValeursExistantes gnd_DBRBCom.Rech_NomPersAffecter = v_ValeursNomsExistantes
Call gnuid_DBRBCom.Refresh
FinSub : Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_DBRBCom, gc_Element_DBRBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
